description: Spotify is looking for a creative, strategic, and sharp editorial voice to join the US Podcast Editorial team. In this role, you'll lead high-visibility editorial projects end to end, partner cross-functionally as a creative and content expert, and shape how listeners discover and engage with podcasts and emerging formats on Spotify. The ideal candidate is a strong writer with a distinct editorial point of view who operates with independence and thrives at the intersection of creative judgment and platform strategy. This role reports into the Associate Director, Podcast Editorial & Audience Development.

lists.content:
• Drive and lead strategic editorial projects from brief through execution and results, including tentpole programming, format testing, and seasonal initiatives
  • Write compelling editorial copy and commentary that brings Spotify's editorial voice to life across curated surfaces and promotional moments
  • Partner cross-functionally as a creative and content expert across workstreams spanning product, personalization, and marketing
  • Own curation of high-complexity or high-visibility editorial surfaces, maintaining quality, cultural relevance, and freshness
  • Collaborate with Partnerships to develop strategies that grow creator audiences on platform
  • Represent Editorial's perspective in cross-functional working groups and planning conversations
  • Identify cultural moments, content trends, and audience opportunities that can be translated into compelling programming across audio and video formats
  • Collaborate with data and analytics teams to inform editorial strategy and measure impact

• 5+ years of experience in editorial, content strategy, or audience development within media, digital, or audio
  • An exceptional writer and editor with a sharp voice and the ability to craft copy that resonates with diverse audiences
  • A strong editorial point of view paired with the ability to translate creative instincts into strategic plans
  • Proven ability to lead complex projects independently and drive them to measurable outcomes
  • Skilled cross-functional collaborator who can partner effectively with product, marketing, and technical teams
  • Deep knowledge of the podcast and audio/video landscape, including creators, publishers, formats, and audience trends
  • Curious and proactive about emerging tools and technology, including AI, and how they can amplify editorial work
  • Comfortable working with data to inform decisions and demonstrate editorial impact
  • A sharp cultural antenna with genuine enthusiasm for connecting audiences with voices and content they'll love

• This role is based in Los Angeles.
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.
  • We ask that you come into the office 2–3 days per week.
